errors.text_span: 按字母或语义顺序排列，无明显排序规则
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that there is 'no obvious sorting rule' for the categories, when the bars are clearly sorted in descending order of their numerical value.
The description does not mention that the vertical (y) axis has no title or label.
The description states that the unit for the y-axis is '个' (items/count), but this unit is not specified anywhere in the figure. This is an inference, not a direct observation from the chart.
